name: CODbox — Cash on Delivery for WooCommerce
author: codbox

sections.description:
CODbox is a phone app for WooCommerce stores that sell with cash on delivery. This plugin connects your store to the app, so you can handle every order without opening WordPress.

What you can do in the CODbox app

  • Get a notification on your phone the second a new order arrives.
  • Confirm the buyer with one tap: call, Viber or WhatsApp with a ready-made message.
  • Move orders through phases: new, confirmed, packed, shipped, delivered. Every change updates the WooCommerce order by itself, with an order note.
  • Add courier and tracking numbers, one by one or for the whole day at once.
  • Print A4 shipping labels with the address, items, cash-on-delivery amount and a barcode, six per sheet.
  • See how much cash each courier still owes you (Pro and Max plans).
  • See your real profit from purchase costs you enter on your products (Max plan).
  • Blacklist buyers who refused a parcel: they can still buy in your store, but cash on delivery is hidden for them at checkout (Max plan).

The app works on iPhone and Android in the browser and can be added to the home screen. It is available in English and Serbian, and works with any courier and any currency.

What this plugin adds to your store

  • Connects your store to CODbox with a one-time code and creates the WooCommerce webhooks for you.
  • Receives order changes from the app (phase, courier, tracking and pre-advice numbers) and updates your orders.
  • Adds a Purchase cost field to products and variations (used only by CODbox to show profit, never shown to buyers).
  • Hides cash on delivery at checkout for buyers on your CODbox blacklist. Works with the classic checkout and the block checkout.
  • Shows the CODbox phase, courier and tracking number on the order screen.

Pricing

The plugin is free. The CODbox app has a 14-day free trial with every feature, no card required. After that, plans start at €9.90 a month. See codbox.app.

External services

This plugin connects to CODbox, an external service run by the plugin author at https://app.codbox.app. CODbox is needed for the plugin to do anything: it is where you see and manage your orders.

What is sent, and when:

  • When you click Connect on the Settings → CODbox page: your connection code, your site address, and your WordPress, WooCommerce and plugin versions.
  • Right after connecting, and when you press “Import last 50 orders” in the app: your most recent orders (20 after connecting, up to 50 on import).
  • Every time an order is created or updated in WooCommerce (through WooCommerce webhooks): order number, status, date, totals, currency, payment method, ordered items with their options and purchase costs, buyer name, phone, email, billing and shipping address, and the order note.

What CODbox sends to your site:

  • When you change an order in the app: the new phase, courier, tracking and pre-advice numbers (to /wp-json/codbox/v1/order-update).
  • When you change your blacklist: the phone numbers and emails on it (to /wp-json/codbox/v1/blacklist).
  • When you press Import in the app: a request to send recent orders (to /wp-json/codbox/v1/resync).

Every request is signed with a secret key that only your store and CODbox know, and requests older than 5 minutes are rejected. Nothing is sent before you connect, and nothing is sent after you disconnect or delete the plugin.

  • CODbox terms of service: https://codbox.app/terms
  • CODbox privacy policy: https://codbox.app/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Create a free account at app.codbox.app/signup and copy your connection code (it looks like CB-XXXX-XXXX).
  3. In WordPress go to Settings → CODbox, paste the code and click Connect.
  4. Open app.codbox.app on your phone. Your recent orders are already there.

Optional: open your products and fill in Purchase cost (under General, and in each variation) to see your profit in the app.
sections.faq:
Will it slow down my store?

No. Orders are sent with WooCommerce webhooks, which run in the background. The plugin adds no scripts or styles to your store pages.

Do I need a CODbox account?

Yes. The plugin connects your store to the CODbox app, where you manage the orders. You can start with a 14-day free trial, no card required.

Does it work with the block checkout and HPOS?

Yes. CODbox works with the classic and block checkout and with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Which couriers are supported?

Any courier. The app has a list of couriers from the Western Balkans (Pošta Srbije, X Express, BEX, D Express, AKS, City Express, BH Pošta and more) and international ones like GLS, DPD and DHL.

Do I need the paid WhatsApp API?

No. Messages open in your own WhatsApp or Viber, already written. You just press send.

What happens when I disconnect or delete the plugin?

Disconnecting removes the CODbox webhooks, so no more orders are sent. Deleting the plugin also removes its settings and the local blacklist. Your WooCommerce orders are never changed by disconnecting.

Can a blacklisted buyer still order?

Yes, but only with other payment methods. Cash on delivery is hidden for their phone number and email, and a message explains why. You can change that message in Settings → CODbox.
sections.changelog:
0.6.0

  • Shipped orders show the courier, tracking number and a “Track your parcel” link in the email to the buyer and in My account.
  • Link to the courier tracking page on the order screen.
  • New setting to turn the tracking block off.

0.5.0

  • Declares compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS and the block checkout.
  • Settings page is fully translatable.
  • Safer handling of messages and checkout data.

0.4.0

  • Purchase cost field on products and variations, used by CODbox to show profit.
  • Blacklist: buyers you block in CODbox cannot choose cash on delivery (classic and block checkout).

0.3.0

  • Order phases (confirmed, packed, shipped, delivered) sync from the app, with courier, tracking and pre-advice numbers.
  • Import the last 50 orders from the app.
  • Sends item options (size, color), email, country and order note.

0.2.0

  • Orders confirmed, shipped or cancelled in CODbox are updated in WooCommerce (note, courier, tracking, status).

0.1.0

  • First version.
